title: Complete Noetherian local rings are J-2
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a commutative Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], where local means that $\mathfrak m$ is its unique maximal ideal. Assume that $R$ is $\mathfrak m$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. Then for every commutative finite type $R$-algebra $A$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], the regular locus $\{\mathfrak p\in\operatorname{Spec}A:A_{\mathfrak p}\text{ is regular local}\}$ is Zariski open [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime, def-weil-regular-scheme]. This property is called J-2.

source.place: Tag 07PJ, proposition-ubiquity-J-2, case (2), Noetherian complete local rings. Cite this independent J-2 theorem, without the excellence or universal-catenarity assertion.
